subtitle: Tell us what you do, where you work, and which requests you actually want to receive.
trustLine: Better setup means fewer bad leads and more relevant requests

progress.hint: Choose at least {{min}} to start receiving matched requests

browse.emptyHint: Choose your first work type to get started

preferences.title: Set Your Priorities
preferences.subtitle: Tell us which jobs you love vs prefer to avoid

wizard.jumpToStep: Jump to any step and update your details.

basicInfo.title: Set up your professional profile
basicInfo.description: Add your name, number, and a short description so clients know who they are speaking to.
basicInfo.whyThisMatters: Clients hire people they trust. A clear profile helps you look professional before the first message.
basicInfo.phoneHint: We can use this for important job notifications
basicInfo.phoneRequired: A phone number is needed before you can receive requests
basicInfo.businessNameOptional: (optional — skip if you trade under your own name)
basicInfo.taglinePlaceholder: e.g. Reliable electrician with 15+ years experience
basicInfo.taglineHint: A short headline that appears with your name, like the line on your van or business card
basicInfo.bioPlaceholder: What do you do best? How long have you been doing it? Keep it simple and practical.
basicInfo.selectZone: Please select at least one work area
basicInfo.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.

serviceArea.title: Where do you work?
serviceArea.description: Tap the areas of Ibiza where you're happy to take jobs.
serviceArea.whyThisMatters: We only match you with requests in the areas you choose.
serviceArea.islandWide: Great! You'll receive jobs from across Ibiza
serviceArea.islandWideTileDesc: We'll match you with jobs anywhere in Ibiza.
serviceArea.selectAtLeast: Please select at least one area

serviceUnlock.title: Which work do you want?
serviceUnlock.description: Choose the work you are happy to take on. We use this to match the right requests to you.
serviceUnlock.whyThisMatters: This is the most important step. You choose the work you want, so your dashboard stays relevant.
serviceUnlock.noNeedAll: You don't need to select everything — just the work you actually want.
serviceUnlock.addMoreLater: You can always add or remove jobs later — nothing is locked in.
serviceUnlock.selectMinimum: Select at least 1 job to continue
serviceUnlock.tapToSelect: Tap any job you're happy to do
serviceUnlock.tapToPrioritise: Tap a selected job to set priority

review.readyDescription: Everything looks good. Turn on your profile and matched requests can appear in your dashboard.
review.almostDescription: Complete the items below to go live.
review.whyThisMatters: Once your profile is active, matching client requests can appear in your dashboard.
review.sendJobsFor: We'll only send you jobs for:
review.changeAnytime: You can change all of this anytime from your dashboard — nothing is set in stone.
review.completeAll: Complete all checklist items to go live
review.liveSuccess: You're active. When a client posts a matching request, it can appear in your dashboard.
review.goLiveFailed: Failed to go live. Please try again.
